purpose: Measure the current fight sprite allocator under a deliberately stressed two-fighter state before assigning VRAM to Suzaku.

test_build.state: two Ken fighters, both full power, P2 AI active

frame_budget_observation.claim_limit: Diagnostic build, audio dummy, no stage, one sealed capture. This is not the final worst-case fight or a sustained 60 fps proof.

decision.interpretation: There were no allocator failures at pool 600, but the observed 72-tile largest contiguous block makes total free tiles alone an inadequate safety margin. Do not reduce the production sprite pool solely to fit the current background candidate.
decision.next_measurement: Repeat matched captures with a stage candidate and candidate pool sizes, using the same fight state, audio driver, instrumentation, and route; record the allocator minimum, largest contiguous block, DMA, scanline pressure, and sustained cadence.
